correctness.rationale: The co-rotating equilibrium follows by zero-sum cancellation, and differentiating each active saturation term yields the real symmetric J=-D+cU^*U, D positive on radial and inactive directions. At noncollinear closure the angular sum map has rank two, which fixes exactly two positive eigenvalues for c>0 and zero for c<0, with a-2 neutrals. For collinear configurations, perpendicular and axial blocks separate; the axial congruence -I+cqq^T gives the exact Gamma=1 crossing. I independently formed an eight-dimensional Jacobian from unequal active vectors (1,.3),(-.7,.5),(-.3,-.8) and one inactive oscillator: inertia (2,1,5) at c=.27 and (0,1,7) at c=-.21, as predicted. Finite spectra check examples; the rank/codimension proof handles all finite M. The excluded beta_j=Mc case and nonlinear behavior at extra neutral modes are not inferred.
